threats.asset: what is being attacked (for example: the refund API)
threats.category: one of: prompt_injection, data_exfiltration, tool_abuse, training_data_poisoning, model_extraction, privacy_leakage, supply_chain, resource_abuse
threats.attack: how an attacker does it, in at least 8 words
threats.mitigation: what you would build or change to reduce it, in at least 8 words
